To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
an allogenecic melanoma cell–lysate–pulsed DC vaccine was safe, well tolerated, and associated with a 40% clinical benefit response in MAGE-positive patients with advanced colorectal cancer.

(1) a mature, allogeneic DC vaccine pulsed with an allogeneictumor lysate is safe and feasible; (2) the vaccine is associated with a clinical benefit response in 40% of patients, and (3) the vaccine is also associated with a prolonged progression-free survival of >27 months in two patients.
the allogenecic melanoma cell line–pulsed dendritic cell vaccine is a well-tolerated and promising treatment for patients with advanced colorectal cancer.

the development and testing of a novel vaccine approach for cancer patients with advanced disease.
the development and evaluation of a dendritic cell-based vaccine for the treatment of advanced colorectal cancer.
the development of novel immunotherapeutic approaches for cancer patients.
